_doc: The gateway's 409 body (`detail`) for a refused macro write, per kind (package 5, Codex R70 VP-I31). `keys` is the exact key set, `reason` the fixed text where there is one. test_macros_gateway.RefusalShape holds the gateway to it and e2e/macroFolder.ts builds its 409s from it: the browser mock answers exactly what the route answers. `revision` is the file on disk read under the same _source_lock as the refusal — null only when the file is gone; a kind without it says nothing about the file.

conflict.reason: Changed on disk — reload or keep editing

deleted.reason: Deleted on disk — reload or keep editing

exists.reason: A macro of that name exists — reload
